blackBox.visibilityToGcl: oracle calls only for solver cases; manual canonicalizer case uses recovered-atom objects to test canonical equivalence rules

claimScope.provesIfPasses: GCL has executable guardrails for duplicate/cancellation canonicalization, weak-under-noise non-identifiability, activation-family mismatch rejection, and minimum equivalent structure under overcomplete budgets
claimScope.doesNotClaim: semantic identity of original hidden neurons, noisy full mixed-block recovery, full GPT-2 FFN extraction, arbitrary 3072-channel recovery, arbitrary 4096D/16384D production LLM decompilation, or broad SOTA status

rows.family: exact duplicate split + equal/opposite cancellation + weak atom
rows.expectedCorrectBehavior: collapse duplicate split, remove cancelling pair, prune weak atom, and keep only observable canonical support

rows.family: weak hidden channel under stochastic output noise and quantization
rows.expectedCorrectBehavior: keep output fidelity but refuse to claim all original hidden channels are identifiable

rows.family: sinusoidal teacher passed to GELU structure finder
rows.expectedCorrectBehavior: do not promote a GELU structure claim when held-out residuals show activation-family mismatch

rows.family: two-channel GELU teacher with five-channel solver budget
rows.expectedCorrectBehavior: select the smallest held-out-valid structure instead of promoting the overcomplete budget
